proposals.evidence: The fourth *udukkhala branch (Prakrit ukkhala/okkhala) explicitly includes Punjabi ukkhalī, Hindi ukhlī/okhlī, Gujarati ukhaḷ/ukhḷũ/ukhḷī and Marathi ukhaḷ. These survey mortar forms fit that reduced-initial ukh-/okh- series. The western forms with weakened or lost final l are qualified family comparisons, not claims that every local ending has an independently demonstrated historical derivation; pestle-glossed homophones and unrelated mortar names are excluded.
